name: Flip of the Coin → Quicksilver — v3 (structural cut at QS bar 54)
description: v3: Fast structural cut. Flip plays drum-heavy outro to bar 200, quick 2-bar crossfade to Quicksilver at bar 54 — a brief bridge moment right before QS drums resume at bar 56. No long blend needed.

tracks.name: Flip of the Coin (Extended Mix)
tracks.notes: 4A (F minor). Drum-heavy outro. Bar 192 energy starts decreasing, bar 200 sparse.

tracks.name: Quicksilver
tracks.notes: 3A (Bb minor). Bar 54 = brief bridge moment (1:45). Drums/energy resume at bar 56. Full breakdown at 64, DROP at 80.

transitions.notes: v3: Structural cut. 2-bar crossfade at Flip bar 200 / QS bar 54. Flip's drums hand off to QS's brief bridge, then QS drums resume. Fast, intentional. Key: 4A→3A adjacent Camelot.
